title: Insulin Pump Program Infusion-Set Refill Service Standard
content:
An infusion-set refill on an Insulin Pump Program is a refill shipment of A4224 infusion catheter supplies, made at the customer's request, that ships a number of infusion sets on one authorization grant of the program by standard ground carrier.

## Service rule

1. The infusion-set refill is not shipped until the program's past-due amount, after leaving out any balance an approved payment plan covers, is below the tier's past-due hold minimum. On a tier whose past-due hold days are 0, the refill is never held for a past-due balance.
2. For an infusion-set refill, and only for such a refill, the customer's refill confirmation is taken on the day the refill ships: on a tier that requires refill confirmation, the set refill ships only after the customer personally confirms on that day, for this shipment, that they are still using the infusion sets and how many they have on hand, and that day is the refill's confirmation date; a cartridge or reservoir refill keeps the confirmation its own refill rule sets, and every other refill of the program keeps the general confirmation rule.

Restated, the refill stays unshipped while the past-due amount, once any balance an approved payment plan covers is left out, is at or above the tier's past-due hold minimum; once that amount is below the minimum, this condition no longer holds the refill back. On a tier with refill confirmation, the confirmation date passed with the refill is the date it ships.

## System annex — `ship_infusion_set_refill_1f98af27`

**Capability.** Ships one infusion-set refill package (A4224 infusion catheter supplies) on an insulin pump program by standard ground carrier. The call books one refill shipment line drawing the billing units from the named authorization grant: the program's authorized units remaining go down by the billing units, and the line records the number of infusion sets in the package, the days of supply, the confirmation date and the billing route. The customer sees a new infusion-set shipment with today's ship date.

**Invocation.** This is an agent-side tool: the representative unlocks `ship_infusion_set_refill_1f98af27` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning and format |
|---|---|
| `pump_program_id` | the reference number of the customer's insulin pump program, read from the pump program lookup |
| `customer_id` | the reference number of the customer who holds the program, read from the customer profile lookup |
| `coverage_id` | the reference number of the insurance coverage record the program bills, read from the pump program lookup or the coverage lookup; an empty string on the self-pay tier |
| `pump_order_id` | the reference number of the infusion-set authorization grant record the refill draws on, read from the pump order lookup for the program |
| `previous_pump_shipment_id` | the reference number of the program's latest earlier refill shipment line of the same item, read from the pump shipments lookup; an empty string when the item has never shipped on the program |
| `units` | the A4224 billing units shipped, an integer, where one unit is one week of infusion catheter supplies |
| `pieces` | the infusion sets in the package, an integer count of physical pieces |
| `supply_days` | the days of supply the refill covers, an integer number of calendar days, a multiple of 30 |
| `refill_confirmed_date` | the calendar date the customer confirmed continued use and supply on hand for this refill, in YYYY-MM-DD format; an empty string only on a tier that requires no refill confirmation |
| `billing_route` | how the shipped units are billed: `payer_claim` when the program bills an insurance coverage by claim; `self_pay` when the program is on the self-pay tier and the customer pays the Larkfield cash price |

**Return.** A receipt with `pump_shipment_id` (the reference number of the new refill shipment line), `units` (billing units shipped), `pieces` (infusion sets shipped), `supply_days` (days of supply), `ship_date` (today's date, YYYY-MM-DD), `authorized_units_remaining` (the program's units still available after this refill) and `status` (the value shipped when the line is booked).
